answer: The shale counter is kept in grove and willow shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2073 identities would post 4953 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
